description.summary: announce an animated change to a layer surface's size

protocol.description:
When another layer surface slides in or out, the space left for the surfaces beside it changes over the length of that animation. Rather than configure a neighbour on every frame of it, the compositor tells the neighbour once what size it is heading for and how long the animation takes, keeps it at the larger of the two sizes meanwhile, and configures it to the final size when the animation ends. The client can then move its own content over the same duration and curve, in its own frames.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: layer_size_transition_manager_v1

description.summary: size transition manager for layer surfaces

interface.description: Manager for creating size-transition objects for layer shell surfaces.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the server that the client will no longer use this global. Existing size-transition objects remain valid until destroyed.

request.name: get_size_transition

description.summary: get size transitions for a surface

request.description:
Create a size-transition object for the given wl_surface, which must be a layer shell surface.
If the given wl_surface already has a layer_size_transition_v1 object associated, the already_exists protocol error is raised.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: surface already has a size-transition object

interface.name: layer_size_transition_v1
interface.description: Announces animated changes to the arranged size of the associated surface. Sizes are in the output's logical coordinate space.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the compositor that the client is no longer interested in size transitions for the surface.

event.name: started
event.description: The surface's arranged size is going from `from` to `to` over `duration_ms`. The surface is kept at the larger of the two sizes for the duration and configured to `to` when it ends; a shrinking surface keeps its size until then, a growing one is configured before this event arrives. A started event during an animation replaces it: the new target and duration are measured from now.

arg.name: from_width
arg.summary: width at the start, logical px

arg.name: from_height
arg.summary: height at the start, logical px

arg.name: to_width
arg.summary: width at the end, logical px

arg.name: to_height
arg.summary: height at the end, logical px

event.name: finished
event.description: The animation ended and the surface has been configured to its final size. Sent after the configure.
